finding.title: Add an Unused Matrix Solely to Enlarge the Frame
finding.why: The new Mtx mtx is never read, written, or passed anywhere in perform. Worker evidence says its only effect is reserving 0x30 bytes, changing the frame from 0x50 to 0x80. An earlier attempt explicitly identifies this as unexplained padding and declines to add it; a later attempt adds precisely that local. A nearby matrix callback is not evidence for an unused matrix in this function.
